tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Repair and Renovation of Kamadhenu Boys Hostel by providing new UPVC window at Veterinary College, Bidar

itemList.description:
Providing & fixing of 3-track x 2-panel sliding windows made out of multichambered UPVC(Matching to RAL-9016) sections and with minimum TiO2(Titanium Dioxide)  at 6PHR with TPE(Thermo Plastic Elastomer) and lead free, gaskets -grey colour having isolated drainage and reinforced with Galvanized Iron profile through-out the window frame. The outer frame having an overall size of 108mm width x 45mm height with reinforcement of 1mm thickness and Sash with overall size of 39mm x 75mm with GI reinforcement of 2mm and mesh sash of size 37mm x 58mm. Coextruded Glazing bead for fixing of glass shall be of size 20mm x 24 mm. Windows shall be provided with 6mm plain float glass, standard hardware& Multi 
point locking system with touch lock. Wall thickness of frame & sash shall 
be of 2mm-2.5mm. Maximum possible size 2419mm x 2200mm. (The 
cost is inclusive of all fixtures and separate charges for minor T&P's shall 
not be made)
